## Struktur Proyek Go

Go tidak memaksakan struktur direktori tertentu, tapi ada konvensi yang diterima komunitas. Berikut adalah layout yang direkomendasikan untuk proyek Go nyata.

## Layout Proyek Sederhana (CLI/Service Kecil)

```
myapp/
├── go.mod
├── go.sum
├── main.go          # entry point
├── README.md
└── .gitignore
```

## Layout Proyek Menengah

```
myapp/
├── cmd/
│   └── myapp/
│       └── main.go  # package main — entry point
├── internal/        # kode private, tidak bisa diimport dari luar
│   ├── handler/
│   │   └── user.go
│   ├── service/
│   │   └── user.go
│   └── repository/
│       └── user.go
├── pkg/             # kode publik yang bisa direuse
│   └── validator/
├── go.mod
├── go.sum
└── README.md
```

## Layout Proyek Besar (Clean Architecture)

```
myapp/
├── cmd/
│   ├── api/main.go       # HTTP API server
│   └── worker/main.go    # Background worker
├── internal/
│   ├── domain/           # Business entities & interfaces
│   │   ├── user.go
│   │   └── repository.go
│   ├── usecase/          # Business logic
│   │   └── user_usecase.go
│   ├── repository/       # Database implementation
│   │   └── postgres/
│   │       └── user_repo.go
│   └── delivery/         # HTTP/gRPC handlers
│       └── http/
│           └── user_handler.go
├── pkg/
│   ├── logger/
│   └── validator/
├── config/
│   └── config.go
├── migrations/
│   └── 001_create_users.sql
├── scripts/
│   └── build.sh
├── docker-compose.yml
├── Dockerfile
├── go.mod
└── go.sum
```

## Prinsip-Prinsip Kunci

### 1. cmd/ untuk Entry Points
```go
// cmd/api/main.go — seminimal mungkin
package main

import (
	"log"
	"myapp/internal/server"
)

func main() {
	if err := server.Run(); err != nil {
		log.Fatal(err)
	}
}
```

### 2. internal/ untuk Kode Private
Semua kode bisnis utama seharusnya di `internal/`. Go secara otomatis mencegah import dari luar module.

### 3. Hindari global state
```go
// Buruk
var db *sql.DB // global

// Baik
type App struct {
	db     *sql.DB
	logger *log.Logger
}
```

### 4. Dependency Injection di main()
```go
func main() {
	db := connectDB()
	repo := repository.NewUserRepo(db)
	svc := service.NewUserService(repo)
	handler := handler.NewUserHandler(svc)
	server := server.New(handler)
	server.Start()
}
```

> **Prinsip:** Mulai sederhana, tambah struktur saat dibutuhkan. Jangan over-engineer di awal.
content_en:
## Go Project Structure

Go doesn't enforce a specific directory structure, but there are community-accepted conventions. Here is the recommended layout for real Go projects.

## Simple Project Layout (CLI/Small Service)

```
myapp/
├── go.mod
├── go.sum
├── main.go          # entry point
├── README.md
└── .gitignore
```

## Medium Project Layout

```
myapp/
├── cmd/
│   └── myapp/
│       └── main.go  # package main — entry point
├── internal/        # private code, not importable from outside
│   ├── handler/
│   │   └── user.go
│   ├── service/
│   │   └── user.go
│   └── repository/
│       └── user.go
├── pkg/             # public, reusable code
│   └── validator/
├── go.mod
├── go.sum
└── README.md
```

## Large Project Layout (Clean Architecture)

```
myapp/
├── cmd/
│   ├── api/main.go       # HTTP API server
│   └── worker/main.go    # Background worker
├── internal/
│   ├── domain/           # Business entities & interfaces
│   │   ├── user.go
│   │   └── repository.go
│   ├── usecase/          # Business logic
│   │   └── user_usecase.go
│   ├── repository/       # Database implementation
│   │   └── postgres/
│   │       └── user_repo.go
│   └── delivery/         # HTTP/gRPC handlers
│       └── http/
│           └── user_handler.go
├── pkg/
│   ├── logger/
│   └── validator/
├── config/
│   └── config.go
├── migrations/
│   └── 001_create_users.sql
├── scripts/
│   └── build.sh
├── docker-compose.yml
├── Dockerfile
├── go.mod
└── go.sum
```

## Key Principles

### 1. cmd/ for Entry Points
```go
// cmd/api/main.go — keep it minimal
package main

import (
	"log"
	"myapp/internal/server"
)

func main() {
	if err := server.Run(); err != nil {
		log.Fatal(err)
	}
}
```

### 2. internal/ for Private Code
All core business code should be in `internal/`. Go automatically prevents imports from outside the module.

### 3. Avoid Global State
```go
// Bad
var db *sql.DB // global

// Good
type App struct {
	db     *sql.DB
	logger *log.Logger
}
```

### 4. Dependency Injection in main()
```go
func main() {
	db := connectDB()
	repo := repository.NewUserRepo(db)
	svc := service.NewUserService(repo)
	handler := handler.NewUserHandler(svc)
	server := server.New(handler)
	server.Start()
}
```

> **Principle:** Start simple, add structure as needed. Don't over-engineer at the beginning.

quiz.question_id: Mengapa lesson menyarankan file `cmd/api/main.go` tetap seminimal mungkin?

options_id: Agar `main` fokus menjadi composition root dan menyerahkan detail ke package lain
Karena file `main.go` dibatasi 50 baris oleh Go
Karena logic bisnis hanya boleh berada di `pkg/`
options_en: So `main` stays focused as the composition root and delegates details to other packages
Because business logic may only live in `pkg/`

quiz.question_id: Apa manfaat utama menaruh core business code di `internal/`?
quiz.question_en: What is the main benefit of placing core business code under `internal/`?
options_id: Go otomatis mencegah import dari luar module sehingga API internal lebih terlindungi
Kode di sana pasti lebih cepat
Compiler memberi optimasi khusus hanya untuk `internal/`
options_en: Go automatically prevents imports from outside the module so the internal API is better protected
Code there is guaranteed to be faster
The compiler gives special optimizations only to `internal/`

Because `sql.DB` may never be global in Go
Because global state always causes a panic

Gunakan clean architecture sejak hari pertama apa pun ukuran proyeknya
